structured.approach: Attempt 2 fixes the G2 refusal: three claims cited ci.mjs, package.json and CLAUDE.md, which had not been read in this session. I read all three repository files again in this session, plus README.md and the earlier draft. I then rewrote task.components.md in full. The content of attempt 1 is kept; the changes are the attempt number, a revision note, and citations that now point only to files read in this session. Attempt 1 had already read the six inputs and the tool view, mapped feat.design B4 for TSK-07 onto the actual code, and kept the change inside the TSK-07 file budget. Its minimum-code approach was to append everything to the existing index.js, so no new module is needed and ci.mjs needs no change. A verifier checked that draft and its two attribution fixes are kept.

claims.text: ap_portal currently exports VERSION, LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary from src/ap_portal/index.js, with VERSION '2.3.0'.
formatAmount formats through Number(value || 0).toFixed(2), a binary float. It conflicts with D-2026-044, so renderOverdueRisk must not use it, and formatAmount stays unchanged (TQ-2).
renderAgingSummary builds HTML with template strings and escapes nothing, so the new function follows its pattern but adds HTML escaping for id and vendor.

ci.mjs syntax-checks every .js file in src/ap_portal, runs tests/*.test.js with coverage over src/** and NODE_PATH 'src', requires coverage of at least 90, and flags lines matching console.log or eval( and lines longer than 140 characters.
package.json holds version 2.3.0, private true and the ci script 'node ci.mjs', and has no dependencies. Only its version changes, moved together with VERSION in index.js.
The repository rule is to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour. The version lives in src/ap_portal/index.js, and branches follow main, dev and feature/<story>.

The components to create in index.js are RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. The export object is updated additively.

toTwoDecimalString accepts only strings matching ^-?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$, pads them as text, and otherwise throws TypeError. renderOverdueRisk returns '' for missing, null or [] and throws TypeError for any other non-array rows and for a non-integer days.
The files in budget are src/ap_portal/index.js, package.json (version only) and tests/portal.test.js. LABELS, formatAmount, renderAgingSummary and their tests must not change.
The new unit tests map to AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 and TRD tests T-12 to T-16, including the error-branch tests needed for the coverage bar.
Work happens on branch feature/story with write access confirmed. The branch-name question RAQ-1 is carried.

open_questions: CQ-FE-1 (non-blocking): ap_portal has no stylesheet. Where are the risk-high, risk-medium, risk-low and risk-unknown styles defined? Interim answer: outside ap_portal, because the host page is out of this design. Owner: UX lead.
CQ-FE-2 (non-blocking): confirm the exact next minor version for VERSION and package.json (one minor step from 2.3.0). Owner: Developer.
RAQ-1 (carried, non-blocking): is feature/story the intended branch for TSK-07? Interim answer: use feature/story, with commits prefixed STORY-07.
structured.summary: I rewrote task.components.md in full for attempt 2. The refusal said three claims cited ci.mjs, package.json and CLAUDE.md without those files being read in this session. All three, plus README.md, have now been read in this session, and the citations refer only to them. The content is the same as attempt 1. The TSK-07 change stays in the existing src/ap_portal/index.js: two constants, three private helpers, the exported renderOverdueRisk, and the export and VERSION lines. The only other changes are the version in package.json and new tests in tests/portal.test.js. No new module, dependency or CI change is needed, and LABELS, formatAmount and renderAgingSummary stay untouched. There are no blocking questions.
